title: Mario's regression: a device pushed into his wrist
summary: Mario Woods tells of Mario's regression: a device pushed into his wrist, about November 1977 at Aboard craft, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he bends my wrist backwards and he goes down into my wrist with it.

plain: Air Force veteran Mario Woods says that under regression, a kind of guided session meant to recover buried memories, he recalled being aboard a craft in November 1977. He says a being bent his wrist backwards and pushed a device down into it. If true, it would mean something was put into his body that night.
